title: Netflix Unveils The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey Trailer
excerpt:
Melissa McCarthy and Clive Owen star in Netflix’s new limited series.
The drama explores the human tragedy behind an unsolved case.
body_md:
Three decades after the death of six-year-old JonBenét Ramsey, the case remains one of America's most widely discussed unsolved murders. The intense public attention surrounding the tragedy has endured long after the original news coverage.

Netflix's limited series brings Melissa McCarthy and Clive Owen into a dramatization of the case. Its stated focus is not to identify a perpetrator or promote another conspiracy theory, but to explore the human tragedy at the center of the story.

That distinction matters in a genre where the pursuit of answers can overshadow the experiences of those affected. The transformation of a family tragedy into a national media obsession provides an important context for the drama.

The trailer introduces this approach without establishing any new findings about the actual crime. A specific streaming premiere date was not included in the available report.
